description: This file is a shell script intended for testing the error handling capabilities of 'git update-ref'. It includes functions to perform various reference update scenarios, error checks, and test cases to verify correct behavior when handling references within a Git repository.

methods.name: test_update_rejected
methods.description: Tests rejection conditions when updating references, such as conflicts with existing references or prefix issues.

methods.name: df_test
methods.description: Tests adding and deleting references that conflict in D/F scenarios, including symbolic references and packed references.
